scope: Independent V33 layout, raw-bit reconstruction and ring-lifetime source review

stream_map.method: Independent affine enumeration of exact host/device coordinate expressions, not execution of Torch gather

checks.raw_address: ptab + 256 * index + 8 * lane, size_t promotion before multiplication; each warp requests one256B sidecar unit
checks.slot_lifetime: Primary LDS, descriptor LDS and activation LDS precede inherited handback; subsequent sidecar access uses immutable global weights. UPW>1 releases after all unit iterations as before.
checks.unchanged_geometry: WPAY/WBY/SST, producer copy bytes and transaction expectations, release counts and MMA order unchanged versus V32.
checks.fallback: Whole-matrix packed-byte comparison declines compression at772*units+256*raw_count >=1024*units; header alignment introduces no omitted padding for the current configurations. Raw descriptor bit31/index31 is masked before pointer arithmetic; no-raw sentinel sidecar is never read.

limitations: CPU PRMT shim is not GPU compiler/ISA validation.
Affine map proof does not execute CUDA TMA or memory-order semantics.
Declared arrays do not establish ptxas registers, local memory or occupancy.
Sidecar instructions can increase substantially versus V32 singleton repair even when logical bytes increase only modestly. No speed forecast or hardware transaction count is claimed.
First observed resource markers and generic source eligibility do not establish selected profile activation.
